response.overview: Just when these young men think their troubles are over, their problems are just beginning. Young vulnerable guys from ages 18 to 25 are given choices they don't like, and many of them end up on the receiving end. House Managers, who are older and more experienced, make sure that their lessons are learned. These guys are in this situation for a reason - usually fresh out of jail or a close call with the law, or some other past issues. In the Halfway House, they are sober and clean, though, and they have a bed to sleep on (or to do other things on!) But the nice thing is that they are usually straight, lean, and used to putting out. We don't feel bad at all about the fun we have with them - they put themselves in this situation to begin with. It's not our fault. And hell, if we can get away with it, get our dicks wet in the meantime, we don't care one bit.
response.title: Boys Halfway House 3
